about: Concept series for invisibleships.com/concepts, in the order they appear on the page. Each series lists its concepts in reading order. A concept can be in more than one series. This file is the only place series are defined; lib/concepts.ts, the download and Supabase are generated from it (scripts/apply_concept_series.py).

series.name: Telepathic communication
series.description: The author's hypothesis of a telepathic communication system, and of how a person might use it.

series.name: The author's account
series.description: What the author reports he has experienced and been told, and his advice to anyone in the same position.

series.name: Hearing something no one else hears
series.description: What can produce a sound or a voice that only one person hears, how to check it, and what an explanation does.

series.name: Neurotechnology and neural data
series.description: What brain technology can and cannot do today, who owns the data it collects, and the laws written for it.

series.name: Harassment and coercion
series.description: Documented cases of covert harassment, and the methods described in the research.

series.name: Surveillance in everyday life
series.description: Cameras, records and monitoring that reach ordinary people, including children and the people around a target.

series.name: Government cloud: what the contracts show
series.description: What the government cloud records show about spending, where data is kept, and what happens after a system is deployed.

series.name: Who answers for harm
series.description: Cases where regulators, courts or contracts did, or did not, hold anyone to account.

series.name: Public health: what the numbers show
series.description: Suicide, overdose and prescribing figures from the site's public health data, and how to read them.

series.name: How to read this archive
series.description: The limits of the evidence here: what a timeline, a source or a number can and cannot show.
